table.name: TLGNS_SAP_MATERIAL_PLANT
table.description: Plant specific material data as received from SAP by the material interface. SAP material valuation area is also stored in this table because it is identified by the same key: plant.

column.name: PLANT_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_plant_cd. The (supply) plants where this material is available OR produced. Both SAP and Logon do not know about the plant where it IS really produced. SAP: material_plant_data (MARC) / WERKS

column.name: NHM_CODE
column.description: The NHM Code which is used when sending material information back to the SAP for rail orders (NHM = Nomenclature Harmonisee Marchandises - Harmonisiertes Gueterverzeichnis). SAP: material_plant_data (MARC) / STAWN

column.name: MARKED_FOR_DELETION
column.description: Deletion code in SAP. SAP: material_plant_data (MARC) / LVORM. 0=active, 1=deleted. Note that Logon normally has active_flag, with inversed logic. We stick to SAP standards in the tlgns_sap_... tables.

column.name: VAL_PRICE_CONTROL_INDICATOR
column.description: V=Moving Average Price, S=Standard Price. SAP: material_valuation (MBEW) / VPRSV. Logon currently does only store this value, no logic.

column.name: VAL_STANDARD_PRICE
column.description: Standard Price. SAP: material_valuation (MBEW) / STPRS. Logon currently does only store this value, no logic.

column.name: VAL_MOVING_AVG_PRICE
column.description: Moving Average Price. SAP: material_valuation (MBEW) / VERPR. Logon currently does only store this value, no logic.

column.name: VAL_FUTURE_PRICE
column.description: Future Price. SAP: material_valuation (MBEW) / ZKPRS. Logon currently does only store this value, no logic. Its not yet specified, WHICH price (standard or moving average) is stored in this future price, or if another column should be added.

column.name: VAL_FUTURE_VALID_FROM_DAT
column.description: Validity start date of VAL_FUTURE_PRICE. SAP: material_valuation (MBEW) / ZKDAT. Current prices are valid until valid_to - 1 day. Logon currently does only store this value, no logic.
